newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Acoje up 8.33 percent in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Acoje up 8.33 percent in Manila.

text.p: Acoje Holdings Inc jumped by three centavos, or 8.33 percent, to 39 centavos in late Manila trade on Tuesday as investors positioned ahead of its venture into the real estate business, brokers said.
"Acoje was awakened from its slumber early this year after it announced its reorganisation and its venture into real estate," said a trader who did not want to be named.
Acoje, formerly Acoje Oil Exploration and Drilling Co Inc, was reorganised into a holding firm early this year.
It also announced that it has acquired 30 percent in Manila's Metropolitan Club (Metroclub).
Metroclub said it plans to develop the land in a prime site in the Makati commercial district where its sports club is located.
